purpose: Rank active research lanes by the shortest evidence path to a defensible executable threshold. This is not a probability of profit, jackpot prediction, or permission to wager.

priority.name: Ultimate Video Poker — Jotas o Mejor Progresivo
priority.whyClosest: The live jackpot counter already has a same-window cent-level identity cross-match and an exact fixed-strategy progressive EV engine exists. A threshold becomes mechanically computable once the exact Spain paytable, qualifying denomination/credits, baseline Royal award and same-strategy Royal probability are captured.
alreadyStrong: live feed identity cross-match to generic:WAGER_BET
Spanish product confirms Jotas o Mejor Progresivo exists
exact fixed-strategy progressive EV engine implemented

priority.name: Winfall Wishes Jackpot
priority.whyClosest: Spain-specific base RTP, contribution, zero reset and bet-proportional eligibility are known. Worker v10 can accumulate synchronized prospective reset candidates and compute an exact chi-square confidence interval under the conditional exponential/constant-hazard model; point estimates are explicitly insufficient.
alreadyStrong: any-stake eligibility and probability proportional to total bet
one-sided 95% conservative break-even policy implemented in v10
blocking: verified jackpot-award attribution for reset candidates
minimum 10 prospective paired candidates before any conditional fit
fresh verified meter above the one-sided 95% upper break-even bound

priority.name: Jackpot King — Mega Bars Fortune Wheel reference
priority.whyClosest: The shared network, Must-Be-Won-By tiers and a clean 95.50% base reference are known, and reset-distribution telemetry exists in source. The missing game-specific final jackpot hazard per EUR is still a fundamental blocker.
alreadyStrong: clean Mega Bars Fortune Wheel base RTP 95.50%
persistent reset-candidate distribution endpoint in source
v12 generic full-cycle substrate once deployed
blocking: game-specific final jackpot hazard per EUR

priority.name: Danza de los Diamantes — Diamond Bonanza 25c
priority.whyClosest: Spanish RTP, denominations and paylines are known and the feed id is highly suggestive, but exact Spain contribution, live cent cross-match and break-even economics are still unresolved.
blocking: jackpot event probability or equivalent exact EV decomposition

priority.name: Streak of Luck — Spain stateful progressive
priority.whyClosest: William Hill Spain publishes six stake-segmented progressive pools, seed formula, 1.40% contribution, exact 10-result trigger and per-bet-line persistent streak state; Betfair Spain independently confirms Playtech, six jackpots and the 10-win trigger. The remaining blocker is the exact state-transition probability model and fresh tier meter identity.
alreadyStrong: current William Hill Spain exact public game rules
streak counter persists separately per bet-line setting across exit/return
exact public William Hill launcher slug /wh-es/launch/streak-of-luck
blocking: six exact Spain bet-per-line denominations and total stakes
same-configuration base/non-jackpot RTP or exact reel/paytable model
qualifying-win and Bonus Dice state-transition probabilities
exact live meter binding for one Spain tier

priority.name: Classic Video Poker — progressive claim discovery
priority.whyClosest: Botemania's current Casino category explicitly says Classic Videopóker has a growing progressive jackpot, while the exact title page exposes limits and RTP range but no progressive mechanism. This is a genuine separate discovery lane, not an extension of Ultimate Video Poker.
alreadyStrong: current Botemania Casino category-level progressive assertion
1c minimum bet and EUR100 table limit published
Roxor Gaming legal line on exact title page
blocking: exact in-game progressive rules and variant

jackpotReality.targetCapability: Detect a verified positive-EV entry state, specify exact game/stake/budget/validity window, and then accept that jackpot realization remains stochastic.
jackpotReality.greenCanOccurTodayIf: A candidate closes its missing evidence gates and the fresh live meter is simultaneously inside the resulting verified entry region.
